preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of roads is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s <= n and 1 <= t <= n and s != t for s, t in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities, each with indices between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: min_inversions == min(sum(1 for s, t in roads if s not in reachable_from_i) for i in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The minimum number of roads to be inversed is the minimum over all cities i of the number of roads that need to be inversed to make all cities reachable from city i.

postconditions.expression: all(i in possible_capitals for i in range(1, n + 1) if sum(1 for s, t in roads if s not in reachable_from_i) == min_inversions)
postconditions.description: The list of possible capitals contains all cities i for which the number of roads that need to be inversed to make all cities reachable from city i is equal to the minimum number of inversions.
The list of possible capitals is sorted in increasing order.
